ddns_providers.description: List of Dynamic DNS providers to update. Each entry contains credentials and target info.

username.description: Username or hostname alias for the DDNS provider.

password.description: Password or API token for the DDNS provider.

server.description: DDNS provider's update server hostname (e.g., dynupdate.no-ip.com, updates.dnsmadeeasy.com).

port.description: Port for the update server (e.g., '443' for HTTPS). If omitted, inadyn defaults based on scheme (http/https auto-detect).

user_agent.description: Optional custom User-Agent header to use (required by some providers like Cloudflare).

default_provider.description: Default DDNS system protocol to use (e.g., 'dyndns2', 'cloudflare', 'godaddy'). Set this if not using provider-specific detection per entry.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for the background process.

log_file.description: Path to the log file for inadyn output.

check_ip_server.description: Public IP-checking service to determine current public IPv4 address.

check_ip_server_port.description: Port of the IP-checking server (typically 80 or 443).

min_update_interval.description: Minimum number of seconds between updates (prevents over-update throttling by providers).

ipv4_only.description: If true, only use IPv4 lookups (skip IPv6 detection and updates).

ip_interface.description: Network interface name (e.g., 'eth0') to bind IP detection to. If empty, inadyn uses default route.

custom_ip_url.description: Optional custom HTTPS/HTTP URL for public IP detection (overrides check_ip_server).
